plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, repeats a story he has heard linking the 5412 Committee, a secret US government panel that approved covert operations in the 1950s, the billionaire Howard Hughes, and a covert team called the S-force to the killing of President John F. Kennedy. In this version, Kennedy fired Allen Dulles, head of the CIA, and an angry Dulles, together with the Wall Street bank Brown Brothers Harriman, put the S-force back to work to take Kennedy out. If true, it would mean parts of the US secret state turned on their own president.
